SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 28.026758, -80.599788 (Approximated from street_address)
Reported Spill Volume: 2000 gallon
Report DescriptionCALLER IS REPORTING A RELEASE OF APPROXIMATELY 2,000 GALLONS OF HYDROFLUOROSILICIC ACID ONTO THE GROUND AND INTO A STORM WATER DRAIN THAT GOES TO A DRY POND LOCATED ON THE PROPERTY. THE RELEASE OCCURRED BECAUSE WHILE OFFLOADING THE PRIMARY TANK TO REPAIR A LEAK THE HYDROFLUOROSILICIC ACID WAS PUT INSIDE OF A TEMPORARY TANK AND THE ACID BURNED THROUGH THE TEMPORARY TANK. REGARDING WHETHER THE SOURCE IS SECURED, THE TEMPORARY TANK WAS REMOVED FROM THE SITE AND IS NO LONGER AN ISSUE BUT THE FACILITY PRIMARY TANK IS STILL LEAKING INTO THE SECONDARY CONTAINMENT. CALLER STATED THEY ARE UNSURE IF THE STORM DRAIN GOES TO ANY ADDITIONAL LOCATIONS OFF SITE BESIDES THE DRY POND WHICH IS ONSITE.

properties.title: NRC Report: Mercury near City Of York, Pa, PA
properties.summary: Incident Type: STORAGE TANK - NRC Report ID: 996356 - Medium Affected: UNKNOWN - Suspected Responsible Party: THE YORK WATER COMPANY
properties.content:
Report Details
NRC Report ID: 996356
Incident Time: 2011-11-14 18:00:00
Nearest City: City Of York, Pa, PA
Incident Type: STORAGE TANK
Material: MERCURY
Medium Affected: UNKNOWN
Suspected Responsible Party: THE YORK WATER COMPANY
SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 39.933056, -76.732222 (Explicit)
Report Description
WHILE YORK WATER WAS CONDUCTING A ROUTINE TANK CLEANING ON MONDAY, NOVEMBER 14TH THEY DISCOVERED A SMALL AMOUNT OF MERCURY IN THE BOTTOM OF A WATER TANK (THE SILVER LIQUID MERCURY THAT WAS USED IN THERMOMETERS, ETC.). THE WATER TANK SITE SERVES ABOUT 500 CUSTOMERS IN THE WYNDHAM HILLS AREA OF SPRING GARDEN TOWNSHIP, YORK COUNTY, PA. YORK WATER SENT A LETTER TO THESE CUSTOMERS ON NOVEMBER 17TH WITH THE FOLLOWING INFORMATION: THE TANK WAS NOT IN SERVICE AT THE TIME OF THE DISCOVERY AND IT REMAINS OUT OF SERVICE. YORK WATER HAS CONDUCTED A NUMBER OF TESTS THAT CONFIRM NO MERCURY HAS ENTERED THE WATER SUPPLY. YORK WATER BELIEVES THIS SMALL AMOUNT OF MERCURY CAME FROM A PRESSURE TRANSMITTER THAT WAS REMOVED FROM THE TANK A NUMBER OF YEARS AGO. YORK WATER IMMEDIATELY CONTACTED THE DEPARTMENT OF ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION AND CONTINUES TO WORK WITH THEM AND THE ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION AGENCY TO ENSURE PROPER REMOVAL OF THE MERCURY FROM THE SITE. MERCURY HAS A LIMITED SOLUBILITY IN WATER AND IS MUCH HEAVIER THAN WATER. THERE IS NO EVIDENCE THAT THE WATER THAT LEFT THE TANK CONTAINED ANY MERCURY. YORK WATER ALSO HAS HAD AN INDEPENDENT LABORATORY TEST SAMPLES OF THE WATER SUPPLY IN THE WYNDHAM HILLS AREA AND ALL SAMPLES HAVE COME BACK WITH NO DETECTABLE LEVELS OF MERCURY. THE WYNDHAM HILLS TANK WILL REMAIN OUT OF SERVICE UNTIL IT IS THOROUGHLY CLEANED AND TESTED. NO WATER WILL PASS THROUGH THIS TANK UNTIL YORK WATER AND THE DEPARTMENT OF ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION HAVE CONFIRMED THAT THE TANK IS MERCURY-FREE. ALL OTHER WATER TANKS IN YORK’S SYSTEM HAVE BEEN INSPECTED AND CLEANED OVER THE PAST SEVERAL YEARS AND THERE HAVE BEEN NO SIMILAR SITUATIONS. THE YORK WATER COMPANY IS REPORTING THIS TO NRC AS A POTENTIAL RELEASE OF MERCURY. THE MERCURY IS CONTAINED WITHIN A CLOSED AND SECURED CONCRETE WATER TANK THAT WAS OUT OF SERVICE AND SEGREGATED FROM THE WATER SUPPLY AT THE TIME OF THE DISCOVERY.

THE FULL EXTENT OF THE ANOMALY TOWARDS THE NORTHERN END BECAME DIFFICULT TO DISTINGUISH DUE TO CLOUDS AND PROXIMITY TO SHALLOW WATERS.

THE PLATFORM OPERATORS REPORTED THAT THE SHEEN SEEMED TO ORIGINATE FROM ONE SPOT AND WAS NOT A SHEEN PASSING BY THE STRUCTURE. (ONE END OF THE SHEEN STAYED NEAR THE STRUCTURE AND THE SHEEN CONTINUED TO GET LONGER IN THE WINDS AND SEAS.) THE FIELD HELICOPTER WAS DISPATCHED TO FLYOVER THE SHEEN TO DETERMINE SIZE AND POSSIBLE ORIGIN. ORDERS WERE GIVEN TO SHUT EI 237 K PLATFORM IN. THE SHEEN STOPPED SHORTLY AFTER THE PLATFORM WAS SHUT IN. AT THIS TIME WE SUSPECT A SMALL PIPELINE LEAK. AT THE TIME OF THIS REPORT, EI 237 K STRUCTURE REMAINS SHUT IN UNTIL THE SOURCE OF THE SHEEN IS DETERMINED OR WE CONCLUDE THAT THE THE PIPELINE WAS NOT THE SOURCE.

properties.summary: Incident Type: UNKNOWN SHEEN - NRC Report ID: 970846 - Medium Affected: WATER - Suspected Responsible Party:
properties.content:
NRC Report ID: 970846
Incident Time: 2011-02-27 15:00:00
Nearest City: Port Fourchon, LA
Incident Type: UNKNOWN SHEEN
Material: UNKNOWN OIL
Medium Affected: WATER
Suspected Responsible Party:
Skytruth Analysis
THE MOTOR VESSEL FAST TRACK WAS DIRECTED BY THEIR COORDINATOR ON THE MORNING OF 2/27/11 TO TAKE A PASSENGER OUT TO ONE OF THE PLATFORMS IN ORDER TO TAKE PICTURES. AT 0900 THEY LOADED THE PASSENGER ON THE VESSEL AND MADE A RUN TO THE HOLE IN THE WALL. AT THIS LOCATION THEY SET-UP ON DP2 STANDING BY. WHILE STANDING BY THE TRAINING ENGINEER NOTICED BUBBLES BREAKING THE SURFACE OF THE WATER AS THEY SURFACED THEY WOULD CREATE A SHEEN ABOUT 6 TO 8 INCHES IN DIAMETER. THE TRAINING ENGINEER INFORMED THE CAPTAIN ON DUTY WHO THEN INFORMED THE LEAD CAPTAIN AROUND 10:00-10:30. THEY THEN CHECKED TO SEE IF THE THRUSTERS WERE LEAKING. ALTHOUGH THEY HAD SEEN A SHEEN, IT COULD NOT DETERMINED WHERE IT WAS COMING FROM. THE LEAD CAPT. DIRECTED THE CREW TO SHUT THE THRUSTERS DOWN. THE TRAINING ENGINEER SHUT DOWN BOTH THRUSTERS. AFTER MANUALLY BACK LOADING PASSENGERS, THEY PROCEEDED BACK TO THE DOCK. ONCE THE VESSEL WAS TIED UP, THEY STARTED BOTH THRUSTERS AND RAN THEM TO SEE IF THERE WAS OIL LEAKING, NO SHEEN OR OIL WAS DETECTED. LATER THE SAME DAY THEY MADE A RUN TO THE MARCO POLO. WHILE THERE THE THRUSTER MADE A LOUD NOISE. CREW MEMBERS THEN SPOTTED LITTLE OIL BUBBLES IN THE WATER. SAMPLES OF THE HYDRAULIC TANKS WERE TAKEN. IT WAS NOTED THAT THE C-9 TANK HAD MILKY LOOKING FLUID IN IT. WHICH INDICATES THAT THE C-9 THRUSTER ONBOARD THE VESSEL DID HAVE WATER INTRUSION INTO IT'S HEAD TANK. THERE WAS NEVER LOSS OF PRODUCT IN THE HEAD TANK REQUIRING ANY ADDITIONAL OIL TO BE ADDED. AT 0400 2/28/11 THEY CALLED IN THEIR MORNING REPORT INDICATING THAT THE C-9 THRUSTER WAS LEAKING HYDRAULIC OIL. LATER THAT MORNING THEIR COORDINATOR INFORMED THEM NOT TO USE THE C-9 THRUSTER. ON 3/9/11 THE VESSEL WENT TO THE SHIPYARD AND THE FRONT SEAL WAS REPLACED. THE SEALS DID NOT APPEAR TO HAVE ANY WEAR/TEAR AND/OR DAMAGE TO THEM.

REPORT DATE: 07-05-2022 REPORT TIME: 1100 UTC REGION: GULF OF MEXICO SUB REGION: N/A AREA/BLOCK: SHIP SHOAL 291 IMAGE DATE: 07-04-2022 IMAGE TIME: 1638 UTC DATA SOURCE: PLANETSCOPE MODE: MULTISPECTRAL RESOLUTION: 3 METER LOCATION: 28°16"28" N/91°05"34" W AREA: 4.58 SQUARE KILOMETERS CONFIDENCE: MEDIUM-HIGH REMARKS: POSSIBLE, UNCONFIRMED OIL WAS OBSERVED IN SATELLITE IMAGERY. THE ANOMALY HAD A SHARP CONTRAST TO ITS SURROUNDINGS AND HAD AREAS OF SILVERY SHIMMER SUGGESTING THICKER OIL. THE ANOMALY ALSO COINCIDED WITH A PREVIOUS SIMILAR ANOMALY IN THE AREA THE DAY PRIOR. THE ANOMALY MEASURED APPROXIMATELY 8.7 NMI LONG AND 0.13 NMI ON AVERAGE. THIS ANOMALY IS FROM A SUSPECTED REPEAT LEAK SOURCE AND IS BELIEVED TO BE ASSOCIATED WITH BOTH NRC #1340541 AND HOTLINE #10418. WINDS AT THE TIME WERE FROM THE SOUTHEAST AND WERE LIGHT AND VARIABLE. UNCERTAINTIES: THE FULL EXTENT OF THE ANOMALY COULD NOT BE DETERMINED DUE TO CLOUD COVER AND CLOUD SHADOW. THIS ALSO PREVENTED THE ANOMALY FROM BEING DIRECTLY ATTRIBUTED TO A SOURCE. WINDS AT THE TIME WERE VERY LIGHT. SOME FALSE POSITIVES OR VERY DIFFUSE OIL COULD CAUSE SOME AMBIGUITIES. MAPS AND SHAPEFILES CAN BE ACCESSED AT: WWW.OSPO.NOAA.GOV/PRODUCTS/OCEAN/MARINEPOLLUTION/

SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 28.948333, -88.386111 (Approximated from Explicit )
Report Description
TWO SUSPECTED AREAS OF OIL WERE DETECTED NEAR THE BIRD'S FOOT REGION OF LOUISIANA. THE NORTHERN-MOST SLICK ORIGINATES FROM THE DESTROYED TAYLOR PLATFORM AND EXTENDS TO THE NORTHEAST 28.5 KILOMETERS, WHICH IS CONSISTENT WITH THE SURFACE WINDS CLOSEST TO THE PLATFORM. THE SLICK WAS SHIMMERY IN APPEARANCE AND WIDENED SLIGHTLY FURTHEST FROM THE PLATFORM. THIS PART OF THE IMAGE WAS IN PARTIAL SUN GLINT AS WELL, LEADING TO A HIGH CONFIDENCE THAT THIS SUSPECTED AREA IS OIL. THE SOUTHERN OR MORE EASTERN SLICK ALIGNS WITH THE DEEPWATER HORIZON PLATFORM. THIS POSSIBLE AREA OF OIL EXTENDS TO THE SOUTHWEST ABOUT 22 KILOMETERS AND IS VERY THIN. HOWEVER, THE SLICK HAS NO SHIMMERY APPEARANCE EVEN THOUGH IT IS IN PARTIAL SUN GLINT, THE DIRECTION IS NOT CONSISTENT WITH THE WEAK SURFACE WINDS WHICH ARE TO THE SOUTHEAST, AND THE POSSIBLE SLICK ALIGNS AND LOOKS SIMILAR TO SOME BATHYMETRIC EFFECTS IN CLOSE PROXIMITY. THEREFORE, THERE IS ONLY A MEDIUM CONFIDENCE THAT THIS IS OIL. UNCERTAINTIES: THERE IS VERY LITTLE UNCERTAINTY WITH THE NORTHERN MOST SLICK ASSOCIATED WITH THE DESTROYED TAYLOR PLATFORM. THE SOUTHERN OR EASTERN MOST SLICK, ASSOCIATED WITH THE DEEPWATER HORIZON PLATFORM, HAS MULTIPLE UNCERTAINTIES. THE MOST PROMINENT UNCERTAINTY IS THE FACT THAT THE POSSIBLE SLICK ALIGNS, AS WELL AS LOOKS LIKE, SOME OF THE BATHYMETRIC EFFECTS IN CLOSE PROXIMITY TO ITSELF. THE OTHER UNCERTAINTIES ARE LISTED IN THE ANALYSIS SUMMARY AND LEAD TO A MEDIUM CONFIDENCE.
